author: David Greene
description:
EFF legal intern Simar Kaur also contributed to this article.

Americans’ First Amendment right to equal access to official government statements is violated by the Trump administration’s use of Truth Social’s preferential treatment scheme, which blocks people who won’t pay Trump’s company up to $100,000 a month early access to government news, EFF told a federal court.

The First Amendment guarantees that members of the public have equal access to public officials’ public comments, we reminded the court.

title: EFF to Court: Trump's Use of Truth Social's Pay-To-See-Posts-First Scheme Violates Americans' 1st Amendment Equal Access Rights
